BUG~CATCHER~JOSE sent out
Beautifly and Venonat!

The opposing Beautifly hung
on using its Focus~Sash!

It’s extremely effective on
the opposing Beautifly!

It’s super effective on the
opposing Venonat!

Shiftry knocked off the opposing
Venonat’s Eviolite!
Shiftry lost some of its HP!

The opposing Venonat flinched
and couldn’t move!

It’s extremely effective on
the opposing Beautifly!
Arcanine was damaged by the recoil!

A tailwind started blowing
on the~opposing side!

The opposing Kricketune knocked
off Cloyster’s Focus

Tangrowth knocked off the opposing
Kricketune’s Focu
